what: CF Industries makes nitrogen fertiliser. It converts natural gas into ammonia and then into urea and other nitrogen products at large plants in North America, and is building low-carbon ammonia capacity.
customers: Farmers through distributors, industrial users of ammonia, and increasingly buyers of low-carbon ammonia as a fuel.
money: industrial nitrogen and diesel exhaust fluid
moat: Plants using cheap North American natural gas, which gives it a large and persistent cost advantage over European and Asian producers using imported gas.
risks: Nitrogen prices are cyclical and set earnings
Revenue fell about 14% a year over three years before last year's recovery
European producers restarting capacity would increase supply
Natural gas price spikes would compress its cost advantage
opportunities: Revenue grew about 19% last year with a 32% operating margin
Return on invested capital of 22% with cash close to debt
Low-carbon ammonia could become a shipping and power fuel, a new market
watch: Nitrogen prices, natural gas costs, and the low-carbon ammonia project.
